own_design: One fixed goal controls at most four children; child sessions contain no inherited transcript, tool grant or provider binding.
Same central runtime, provider, approval authority, profile admission and SQL run receipts for every child.
A goal reserves a finite sum of provider steps and elapsed execution budget; parent custody outlives child finalizers and durable settlement.
Durable coordination events survive restart as observations; they never replay interrupted child requests.
Owner steering uses the official generated TurnSteerParams v0.163.0 expectedTurnId precondition and an exact request identity; ambiguous writes are recorded without retry.
limits: This is a fixed read-only Git-object partition, not a whole repository review.
